sdsFirstPolicy: No parity module may expose a durable external record that is missing from SDS; add the SDS schema before consuming it in a module manifest.

domains.label: Time, Epochs, And Time Scales

existingSchemas.purpose: Canonical TIMInstant, TIMConversionRequest, and TIMConversionResult records used by foundation/time, including SBAS as a GNSSDate-compatible GPS-family time system, GNSS_WEEK_SECONDS fields for Orekit rollover-reference parity, and an initial CCSDS_TIME_CODE payload for Orekit unsegmented CUC parsing and canonical TAI CUC target formatting plus day-segmented CDS and calendar-segmented CCS parsing.
Legacy time-system command surface; retained as reference only for non-canonical migration debt.
Earth orientation samples needed by UT1 and frame transforms.

gaps: TIM exposes an initial CCSDS time-code payload, but full CDS/CCS segmented-code coverage, caller-selected target formatting metadata, and complete CCSDS parser/writer request semantics are still missing.
TIM does not yet model reusable Orekit DataContext/leap-second-loader provenance.
nextSdsActions: Extend TIM CCSDS time-code records for segmented CDS/CCS target formatting selection and complete parser/writer metadata before claiming full foundation/time CCSDS parity.
Add provenance fields for leap-second/EOP source selection before full Orekit data-context parity.

domains.label: Frames, EOP, And Transforms

existingSchemas.purpose: SANA-derived celestial, spacecraft, orbit, and custom frame identifiers.
Earth orientation parameters for ITRF/TEME/TOD/MOD transforms.
Frame/geodetic transform request/result records used by foundation/frames for Basilisk-compatible PCI, PCPF, and ellipsoid LLA conversions.
Compact state vector with reference-frame tag.
Attitude covariance and frame-tagged attitude states.

gaps: Initial FRM coverage handles explicit DCM PCI/PCPF and ellipsoid LLA/PCPF transforms but not full Orekit dynamic frame/EOP transforms.
No explicit topocentric frame instance record captures station geodetic point and local-axis convention.
EOP coverage needs interpolation/version/provenance metadata for Orekit IERS parity.
nextSdsActions: Extend FRM for dynamic EOP-backed frame transform inputs before full Orekit frames parity.
Add station/topocentric frame instance records before TopocentricFrameTest parity.

domains.label: Orbit State And Propagation Products

existingSchemas.purpose: CCSDS mean-element orbit record used by SGP4 and foundation/orbits.
CCSDS orbit-parameter message with Cartesian and Keplerian fields.
CCSDS orbit ephemeris message with Cartesian samples and covariance.
CCSDS orbit comprehensive message with state, covariance, maneuver, and OD blocks.
Vector covariance message including Cartesian, Keplerian, equinoctial, perturbation metadata, and parabolic Keplerian periapsis radius.
Propagator runtime wire request/result envelopes.
Polynomial ephemeris products.
Maneuver state and status records.
Gravity model identity, central-body selection, equatorial radius, MU, and J2-J6 context used by foundation/orbits Basilisk mean/osculating conversion and J-zonal acceleration.
Coordinate vector record used by foundation/orbits to carry the Basilisk solar radiation pressure central-body-to-Sun vector in AU.

gaps: GRV exposes numeric equatorial radius, MU, and J2-J6 scalar zonal terms but not full coefficient-set metadata or normalized harmonic arrays.
CRD carries a generic vector but does not encode units, so the SRP method documents X/Y/Z as AU at the module contract level.
No standalone orbit-conversion request/result record exists for reusable foundation/orbits imports.
Parabolic OMM mean-anomaly handling and some circular/equinoctial singular conventions are not first-class SDS semantics.
nextSdsActions: Add canonical gravity-field coefficient records before higher-order gravity model parity.
Define orbit-conversion request/result records if foundation/orbits exports reusable conversion APIs beyond CCSDS message transforms.

domains.label: Attitude State And Attitude Products

existingSchemas.purpose: CCSDS attitude comprehensive message with attitude states, covariance, properties, and maneuvers.
CCSDS attitude ephemeris message segments.
CCSDS attitude parameter message shell.
Spacecraft and attitude sensor frame identifiers.
B-spline interpolation request/result records used by foundation/math-bspline and Basilisk constrained attitude maneuver utility parity.

Rigid-body kinematics request/result records used by foundation/attitude-math for Basilisk-compatible MRP, Gibbs-vector, principal-rotation-vector, Euler-angle, scalar-first Euler-parameter, direction-cosine-matrix, elementary rotation-matrix, tilde-matrix, and differential utilities.

gaps: Basilisk MRP error, rate-command, and control-torque payloads are not first-class SDS records.
APM is currently too thin for full Orekit ADM parser/writer parity.
No dedicated attitude-law request/result record exists for attitude/laws module imports.
nextSdsActions: Extend attitude schemas for attitude guidance/control command records before Basilisk FSW wrappers expose those ports.
Expand APM/APM-adjacent records before files/ccsds-messages claims full ADM parity.

domains.label: Shared Math And Numerical Utilities

existingSchemas.purpose: B-spline interpolation request/result records used by foundation/math-bspline and Basilisk constrained attitude maneuver utility parity.

Scalar numerical root-solving, vector-saturation, vector-discretization, scalar-interpolation, and bounded Gauss-Markov sequence request/result records used by foundation/numerics for Basilisk-compatible Newton-Raphson, Saturate, Discretize, linearInterpolation, bilinearInterpolation, and GaussMarkov utility parity.

gaps: NUM currently exposes the Basilisk Newton-Raphson source-vector surface for a quadratic-minus-constant function, the Basilisk Saturate component-wise vector-clamp surface, the Basilisk Discretize component-wise vector-quantization surface, the Basilisk scalar linear/bilinear interpolation source-formula surfaces, and the Basilisk bounded Gauss-Markov sequence statistics surface.
No generic SDS expression, polynomial, derivative callback, or linear algebra utility record exists yet.
nextSdsActions: Extend NUM with broader scalar/vector function families before claiming Orekit solver parity.
Add reusable linear algebra records before porting remaining AVS Eigen conversion utilities as durable module methods.

domains.label: Earth Environment And Force Inputs

existingSchemas.purpose: Atmosphere model family selection.
High-frequency calculation/query record currently used for atmosphere states.
Space-weather flux and geomagnetic activity inputs.
Gravity model identity and central-body selection.
Ionosphere-related data product.
Generic environment/weather and terrain context.

gaps: HFC does not expose Debye length or acceleration-vector output needed by current Basilisk atmosphere ports.
No canonical geomagnetic WMM/IGRF, solid/ocean tide, geoid, troposphere, or displacement model request/result records are available.
No reusable force-model acceleration record exists for HPOP/DSST/Basilisk imports.
nextSdsActions: Promote atmosphere force-output vectors before exposing drag/SRP/gravity force modules.
Add geomagnetic and displacement model records before Basilisk environment and Orekit models parity modules.

domains.label: Observations And Measurement Products

existingSchemas.purpose: Electro-optical observations and image metadata.
Radar observation record.
CCSDS tracking data message shell.
Orbit determination result summary with observation statistics.
Sensor management and tasking metadata.
Sensor detection runtime report for batch detection modules.
Sensor runtime wire envelope for detection plugins.

gaps: Orekit measurement modifiers, residual vectors, and generated measurement requests are not canonical SDS records.
CCSDS TDM parser/writer parity may require richer per-observation typing than the current TDM shell exposes.
Basilisk sensor/filter measurement messages need per-family mapping before durable external exchange.
nextSdsActions: Define measurement request/result/residual records before analysis/iod-measurements and OD filters export module APIs.
Expand TDM or add companion observation records when files/ccsds-messages ports Orekit TDM tests.

domains.label: GNSS Products

existingSchemas.purpose: GNSS observation data points and receiver metadata.
Generic GPS exchange track/waypoint data.
Tracking data products that can carry GNSS-derived measurements.

gaps: No canonical RINEX navigation/observation, ANTEX, SSR, RTCM, Ntrip, or GNSS clock/product records are present.
No DOP request/result record exists for analysis/dop.
nextSdsActions: Add GNSS navigation-product schemas before gnss/navigation-products and files/gnss-products modules.
Add DOP result records before analysis/dop publishes SDK ports.

domains.label: Image And Optical Products
requiredRecords: raw or processed image payload reference

existingSchemas.purpose: EO observation and image quality metadata.
Sensor identity, tasking, and operational statistics.
Sensor detection runtime I/O with target and detection result records.
Geospatial overlay/image reference metadata.

gaps: No canonical raw image/tensor payload descriptor exists for Basilisk optical navigation modules.
No camera intrinsics/extrinsics and optical feature tracks record exists beyond EOO metadata fields.
No standardized processed image product record covers synthetic tracking or segmentation outputs.
nextSdsActions: Add image payload and camera model records before basilisk/optical modules publish durable outputs.
Define optical-navigation feature/result records before FSW optical filters export module APIs.

domains.label: Actuator Commands And Effector State

existingSchemas.purpose: XTCE command and telemetry metadata container.
Satellite bus specification with broad stabilization metadata.
Generic physics command strings and rigid-body simulation slots.
Maneuver status and orbital state around maneuvers.
Actuator, reaction wheel, magnetic torquer, and spacecraft body frame identifiers.

gaps: No first-class reaction-wheel, thruster, magnetic-torquer, VSCMG, motor, or stepper command/status records exist.
PHY contains string placeholders rather than typed actuator command payloads.
XTC can describe command metadata but does not replace typed command/result records for module ports.
nextSdsActions: Add typed actuator command/status/config records before Basilisk effector-interface and dynamics modules expose ports.
Map each Basilisk actuator message family to SDS or explicitly add missing SDS records before implementation.

domains.label: Power And Electrical State

existingSchemas.purpose: Spacecraft bus power generation, payload power, and battery capacity metadata.
Communications payload power metadata.
Power telemetry/command metadata description.

gaps: No typed power-network, battery charge/discharge, solar-array, power sink/source, or EPS command/status records exist.
BUS and CMS expose static capacity/power metadata but not runtime power simulation state.
nextSdsActions: Add EPS/battery/solar-array runtime records before Basilisk power modules expose durable state.
Use XTC only as metadata; add typed FlatBuffers for repeated module data-plane payloads.

domains.label: Thermal State
gaps: No dedicated SDS thermal state or thermal network schema exists.
PHY has a THERMAL_STATE string placeholder but not typed exchange records.
XTC can describe telemetry metadata but does not provide the repeated runtime thermal data-plane record.
nextSdsActions: Add typed thermal node/network and thermal actuator records before Basilisk thermal modules.
Add temperature telemetry payload records or explicitly map them through XTC plus a typed value record.

domains.label: Runtime Telemetry And Module Invocation

existingSchemas.purpose: Plugin manifest and method/port contract metadata.
Plugin invoke envelope.
Typed arena-backed payload frame descriptor.
Runtime entity metadata for shared host collections.
Propagator runtime request/result wire format.
General telemetry and command metadata.
Record envelope for bundled/published artifacts.
Module bundle metadata.

gaps: No generic module health/performance telemetry record exists for runtime timing, memory, warnings, and deterministic replay state.
Basilisk runtime snapshot/restore and message dictionary records are not yet canonical SDS records.
nextSdsActions: Add module runtime health/performance telemetry before large Basilisk scenario replay surfaces.
Add Basilisk message dictionary and snapshot records before full basilisk/runtime parity.
